instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nexus Ventures is a small biotech company specializing in developing novel monoclonal antibody therapies for autoimmune diseases. They are currently leading promising Phase II clinical trials for rheumatoid arthritis, leveraging proprietary biomarker data to identify high-potential drug candidates quickly. The core innovation focus lies in accelerating the candidate pipeline through advanced computational methods.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered €2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
answers.strategicGoals: We are targeting a 20% improvement in operational throughput without increasing headcount. Our processes have grown organically over the years and are overdue for standardization. We suspect that workflow digitization, basic automation, and better data integration between our core systems can unlock significant productivity gains within our current cost structure.
answers.additionalContext: Innovation initiatives must compete directly with high-priority operational demands for the small technology team. The extremely tight budget requires highly focused, measurable impact projects.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven In-Silico Target Prioritization Engine
opportunities.rationale: Develop a targeted AI model to predict protein folding and binding affinity with higher precision than current methods, significantly reducing the time spent in wet lab validation. This directly addresses the core innovation need while maintaining formal process integrity.

first_actions: Hire a specialized computational biologist consultant (time/talent barrier mitigation)
Allocate 15% of budget to build initial data pipeline integration for the modeling tool
Define MVP metrics: reduction in candidate screening time by 30%
execution_plan.success_metric: Screening cycle time reduction of 40% within 9 months
milestones: Q3: Integration with existing LIMS/data warehouse finalized.

opportunities.title: Automated Clinical Protocol Generation & Monitoring (Gen-Protocol)
opportunities.rationale: Implement a radical generative AI approach to automatically draft and monitor complex clinical trial protocols based on the specific biomarker data gathered. This would drastically reduce the 'time' barrier in protocol development and quality assurance, offering exponential efficiency gains.

first_actions: Identify regulatory experts for initial framework definition
Pilot Gen-Protocol tool only for one non-critical biomarker subset
Establish an internal task force dedicated to ethical and compliance review.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in protocol drafting time from 8 weeks to 1 week
milestones: Q3: Framework definition and baseline testing complete.

next_steps.action: Conduct a formal feasibility study and ROI analysis for the AI-Driven Target Prioritization Engine.
Establish a 'Venture Sprint' budget line item (€5k) to allow rapid, small-team execution on low-risk efficiency gains.

key_weaknesses: Severe resource constraints (13% budget) make sustained, long-term innovation difficult to fund beyond immediate operational needs.
Reliance on a small technology team limits the ability to dedicate staff to complex, multi-year radical projects.
Innovation efforts are currently squeezed by day-to-day operational demands, lacking formal ring-fenced time or dedicated innovation leadership.
